page_topic_one_liner: Sitemap creation and optimization — XML, HTML, sitemap index, GSC submission, and crawl discovery

Secondary: crawler bot icon following dotted arrow path from sitemap file into 4 mini page tiles (representing discovered URLs)
Tertiary: small robots.txt + sitemap cross-reference badge showing Sitemap: declaration line
anti_patterns: LLM chat panel as hero (this is sitemap XML not GEO)
Generic folder tree without XML sitemap syntax
